[[File:Volot ignition switch Crackens RFG.png|thumb]]
'''Volot''' was a design for [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] and [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] ignition switches developed during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Volot design differed from previous ignition switches in that it contained a [[micro-generator]]. This was important when jury rigging a simple lock picker, which required the micro-generator to operate.<ref name="Cracken">''[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|Cracken's Rebel Field Guide]]''</ref>
